hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_name + "|" + (.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.file) + "|" + (.tool_response.success // "true")' | { read -r payload; IFS='|' read -r tool file success <<< "$payload"; if [ "$success" = "true" ] && [ -n "$file" ] && [[ "$file" != *"DOCUMENTO_PROJETO.txt"* ]]; then printf "[%s] %s: %s\n" "$(date -u +'%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%M:%%S UTC')" "$tool" "$file" >> "C:/Users/Public/Documents/chikane-garage-novo/DOCUMENTO_PROJETO.txt"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
